answer: What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, weighted by independent path length, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The canyon holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
